title: 第813章 逃吧往大宇宙之外逃第812章 等急了吧
content_zh:
妖神收回目光，长枪横扫，驱逐五色毫光，隔绝窥探；
梵武等妖族至尊面色凝重中带着一丝绝望......
“大人......当真无力回天了么？”梵武开口，语气艰涩。
他不敢想，若是妖神败了，留给妖族的将会是怎样的命运......
恐怕，比之前昆玉曾看见过的，还要绝望百倍！
楚元，从来都不是一个心慈手软的人.......
妖神摇头：“之后我与楚元交手......你们见机而逃吧；
逃的越远越好，离开大宇宙！”
“离开大宇宙......能去哪儿？”梵武迷茫道；
大宇宙外无尽虚空，根本没有生灵存在的土壤！
能量没有，法则不显.....
即便是至尊，在只进不出的情况下，又能坚持多久？
“总又一线生机的.......”妖神沉默片刻，忽然道：“你们可知，武道的根源？”
妖族至尊自然是不知晓的，故而不等他们回答，妖神便继续说道；
“若说第二、第三、第四第五时代，生灵知晓武道，是因为法则本源之海印记融入所携带信息的缘故......
可第一时代的法则本源之海，却无从摄取这些信息；
武道，自不是无中生有的。
祂又为何以成就自身小宇宙，为武者终极目标？”
梵武沉默不语，妖神说的这些，跟现在的局势有关系么？
若是闲暇之时，他很有兴趣了解这些秘辛；

可现在都什么时候了.......
倒是摩柯心中一动，询问道：“我等都知，武道的终极是成就武者自身宇宙；
可却从来没有见到、或者听说过。
但这个理念一代代流传下来，历经五个时代从未有人质疑......
到底是为何？”
如果不算楚元的话，武者中最强当属妖神，可妖神此时走的也是融合法则本源之海的路子......
那为什么会有体内宇宙的说法呢？
妖神赞许的看了他一眼，轻声道：“因为，大宇宙曾经见证、并记录......我也见过。”
梵武等人心中震惊，随后更加不解；
倘若真有这等武者存在，第一时代怎么会轮到妖神当家做主？
难道那人是圣人，什么都不求？
妖神似看穿了他们的想法，又开口道：“他却并非第一时代生灵，他不属于大宇宙！
我不知道他从何而来，但他撒下武道的种子，而后离去......”
“什么！？”
content_en:
The demon god withdrew his gaze and swept across with his spear, driving away the five-colored light and blocking out prying eyes;
Fanwu and other demon supremes had solemn expressions with a hint of despair...
"Sir...are you really powerless?" Fan Wu spoke in a difficult tone.
He didn't dare to think about what kind of fate would be left to the demon clan if the demon god was defeated...
I am afraid that it is a hundred times more desperate than what Kun Yu has seen before!
Chu Yuan has never been a soft-hearted person...
The demon god shook his head: "I will fight Chu Yuan later...you should run away when you see the opportunity;
Escape as far away as possible, leave the universe! "
"Leaving the universe... where can we go?" Fan Wu said confused;
There is endless void outside the big universe, and there is no soil for living things to exist at all!
There is no energy, and the laws are not revealed...
Even if you are the Supreme, how long can you hold on if you can only go in but not get out?
"There is always a glimmer of hope..." The demon god was silent for a moment, and suddenly said: "Do you know the origin of martial arts?"
The Demon Clan Supreme naturally didn’t know, so the Demon God continued without waiting for their answer;
"If we talk about the second, third, fourth and fifth eras, the living beings know the martial arts, it is because the seal of the sea of origin of the law is integrated into the information carried...
But the ocean of the origin of the laws of the first era has no way of absorbing this information;
Martial arts is not created out of nothing.
Why does He regard the achievement of his own small universe as the ultimate goal of a warrior? "
Fan Wu remained silent. Does what the demon god said have anything to do with the current situation?
If he had free time, he would be very interested in learning these secrets;
But what time is it now...
But Moko was moved in his heart and asked: "We all know that the ultimate goal of martial arts is to achieve the warrior's own universe;
But I have never seen or heard of it.
But this idea has been passed down from generation to generation, and no one has ever questioned it after five eras...
Why? "
Excluding Chu Yuan, the strongest among the warriors is the demon god, but the demon god is also taking the path of merging with the sea of origin of laws...
So why is there such a thing as the inner universe?
The demon god glanced at him approvingly and said softly: "Because, the universe has witnessed and recorded it...I have seen it too."
Fanwu and others were shocked, and then became even more puzzled;
If such warriors really existed, why would it be the demon god's turn to take charge in the first era?
Could it be that that person is a saint and doesn’t ask for anything?
The demon god seemed to have seen through their thoughts and said again: "He is not a creature of the first era, he does not belong to the universe!
I don’t know where he came from, but he sowed the seeds of martial arts and then left..."
"What!?"
